summary: Phase 3+4+2 full-stack testing (Branch Document Vault, Recurring Expense Scheduler, Joining Kit, Procurement Catalog, Budgets). 15/15 pytest backend cases green; all 3 UI pages render with seeded data under /app/branch-operations, /app/budgets, /app/joining-kit. Sidebar entries (Branch ops, Budgets, Joining kits) present for company_admin.

issues: FY selector defaults to FY2026 (= current Indian FY Apr 2025-Mar 2026), while seed scripts target FY2027. Users must manually switch FY to see the seeded Phase-2 demo data. Consider defaulting to the FY where seed data exists, or seeding current FY too.

action_items: [LOW] Add data-testid attributes on row-level cards (doc-row-{id}, rec-row-{id}, rec-run-now-{id}, budget-tile-envelopes/total/utilized/remaining, kit-template-{id}) to make Playwright tests more stable.
[LOW] Consider defaulting Budgets FY selector to the FY where seeded envelopes exist (currently defaults to current FY = FY2026, but seed targets FY2027).
critical_code_review_comments: [INFO] _fy_label_now() labels FY by end-year (FY2026 = Apr 2025 → Mar 2026) per code comment — matches spec convention (FY2027 = Apr 2026 → Mar 2027). No bug, just document this clearly in UI help text.

[INFO] Budget preflight picks most-specific envelope correctly via _specificity(). Expense _utilization() does a Python-level sum instead of Mongo aggregation — acceptable at current scale but will be slow if expense_claims grows beyond ~10K/branch. Consider $group aggregation later.

[INFO] branch_ops_routes._check_branch_access has a loose fall-through that silently allows sub_manager/assistant_manager across branches — intentional per comment but worth tightening when row-level ACLs land.
[INFO] Recurring run-now idempotency works via (template_id, period_month) unique lookup; confirmed duplicate POST returns same run/expense id.
[INFO] Joining Kit issuance correctly snapshots template items at creation (tested: items[].length matches template exactly).
